mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.member_id, a.stock_id, a.direction, a.target_price, a.created_at, a.triggered_at, s.name, s.type, s.market, s.industry FROM price_alert a JOIN stock s ON s.stock_id = a.stock_id WHERE a.member_id = #{memberId} AND a.triggered_at IS NULL ORDER BY a.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO price_alert (member_id, stock_id, direction, target_price, created_at, triggered_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{stock.stockId}, #{direction}, #{targetPrice}, #{createdAt}, #{triggeredAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE price_alert SET triggered_at = #{triggeredAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM price_alert WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
